evidence_label: CERTIFIED if and only if an independently reconstructed formula and checked DRAT/LRAT establish UNSAT; otherwise record SAT, TIMEOUT, or ERROR exactly
motivation: The aggregate certificate excludes every assignment with at most six changed core edges. The first unexplored shell is therefore radius seven. Instead of blindly increasing the timed-out aggregate radius-seven solve, open one deterministic seven-edge cut selected by the independently reproduced proof-core occurrence ranking.

ranking.selection_rule: Take ranks 1 through 7 in full_occurrence_order_ranking; equal scores retain the first-scored order explicitly recorded by the audit.

solver.name: Glucose3
solver.proof_chain: ASCII DRAT checked by pinned drat-trim, converted to LRAT, then checked by pinned lrat-check

outcome_policy.SAT: Export the 43-vertex graph, verify every five-subset independently in Python and by the C++ bitset verifier, and audit the fixed 659-edge boundary before any construction claim.
outcome_policy.CERTIFIED_UNSAT: Record a scoped exclusion of this exact 244-edge cut only. Do not generalize to all radius-seven assignments or global order-43 nonexistence.
outcome_policy.TIMEOUT: Record timeout only; do not infer satisfiability.
outcome_policy.ERROR_OR_UNCERTIFIED: Record the infrastructure or proof-checking failure and make no mathematical claim.
